Aupapātikasūtra
(uvavAiyasutta or ovavAiyasutta) Jain. Pkt. connected with Ācārāṅgasūtra an. considered a. first Upāṅga; deals with gods an. those in hell; full of vaṇṇas or descriptions. Sūtras 168-189 in the end are in verse, an. the rest mostly in prose. For analyses see Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas, p.. 137-8; Weber, Ind. Stud. XVII. p.. 389-411; Ind. Ant. XX. p.. 367ff.
